name: LightCraft v0.7.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Add shared docking while preserving photo tools and catalog drops by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/869
* Integration batch 26: 31 reviewed contributor PRs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/975
* Brush mask: holding the brush still adds no coverage; flow builds up by passes (#518) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/767
* KEY-ESC: Esc leaves the crop tool before leaving Detail by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/772
* LR-CROP-FLIP: Flip H / Flip V show in the crop tool by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/773
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: SRF and DSLR-A100 raws open again (#702) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/774
* LR-BEHAV-GPU: no indirect-call validation pipeline, which Intel Metal fails to compile (issue #250) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/779
* System Info, All Metadata and What's New end with one Close button, like About (#782) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/785
* LR-EDIT-RESET: Reset Edits returns a raw to its import defaults, sharpening and colour NR included by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/792
* Fix #714: mouse wheel zooms the loupe around the pointer by @PierrunoYT in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/799
* Fix reject flag spacing in the bottom toolbar by @shurkanTwo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/803
* Block background interaction while dialogs are open by @shurkanTwo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/809
* LR-VIEW-BEFOREAFTER: zoomed side by side / stacked views stay in their panes by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/817
* CR3: decode CRX quantisation step 44 (QP 168), Canon EOS R50 C-RAW by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/829
* LR-META-EXIF-FULL: All Metadata shows the raw image's Compression by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/831
* web: stop the release zip shipping Cargo build artifacts (#793) by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/848
* LR-CROP-STRAIGHTEN: the rotate pointer faces away from its side of the crop box by @john01px2022 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/855
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: near-black pixels no longer turn white in the camera look by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/858
* test(engine): cover mixed Windows path separators in folder synchronization by @THEtheChad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/873
* LR-HDR-EXPORT: HDR renders keep the camera tone curve in the midtones by @robmdunn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/877
* fix(ui): show completion feedback for library maintenance and Auto Sync by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/883
* fix(query): prevent catalog pagination overflow on 32-bit web builds by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/885
* Tests: hold the MCP export-cancel test's export after its first photo until cancelled (#674) by @ingolfteetz in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/935
* Dropping photos with XMP sidecars no longer imports the sidecars as presets (#936) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/943
* Masking: Color Range "Pick" button samples the photo by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/957
* LR-VIEW-BEFOREAFTER: click tools work in the Before view of side by side / top-bottom by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/746
* LR-VIEW-COMPARE: a filmstrip click shows the photo in Compare by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/747
* LR-EDIT-COLOR-WB-PICKER: the selector button does what W does by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/748
* raw: find the saturation plateau despite stray samples above it (CR2 white level) by @TicT4x in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/753
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: EOS R5 Mark II crop-mode CR3s develop without a black band by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/754
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Nikon D4 image area and white level, measured against its camera JPEG by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/759
* Return applies the Copy Settings and Paste Selected Settings dialogs (#735) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/760
* Integration batches 27–30: 80 reviewed contributor PRs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/981
* Fix immediate slider value entry and Reset precedence by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/952
* fix(macos): validate signed app in final DMG (#863) by @xristosmoug in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/959
* LRC-LIB-CATALOG-IMPORT: describe raws from their headers without reading pixel data (step 1 of #832) by @ingolfteetz in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/961
* LR-IMP-PROFILES: .cube-only imports report their profiles and failures (#942) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/970
* LR-EDIT-DETAIL-DENOISE: dismissing the model setup turns AI Denoise back off (#922) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/971
* UI: star rating previews the hovered rating, Info tab and bottom bar (#647) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/665
* Headless sessions honour LIGHTCRAFT_SAM3_DIR for the SAM 3 model folder (#619) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/666
* Issue #99: lock tests: keep the child-process test from overlapping the others by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/679
* Right-click ▸ Add to Album offers New Album…, also with no album yet (#676) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/685
* DNG bad-pixel opcodes: cap the pixels they repair by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/686
* XMP merge: keep refusing repeated attributes, in linear time by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/687
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Sony DSC-R1 reads its SR2SubIFD (black, white balance, crop): seed derived from the key by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/689
* LR-PREF-PERFORMANCE: cover every GPU kernel build with the crash marker, catch internal compile errors (#250) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/694
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: keep Sony aspect crops outside validated corrections by @QuirkyTurtle94 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/695
* In-window menus: a scrolled menu draws no scrollbar over its shortcut text (#691) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/696
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: decode Kodak DCS520C raw TIFF (two-component lossless JPEG with response curve) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/700
* Read Lightroom spot removal (crs:RetouchAreas, RetouchInfo) from sidecars and presets by @aayusharora in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/703
* spot.findBlemishes: heal small blemishes on detected faces (classical, no new model) by @aayusharora in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/704
* Catalog lock: release the library lock explicitly on drop, not by closing the handle (#680) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/710
* GPU fallback reason per render; the export fallback test no longer reads process-wide state (#675) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/712
* docs: point to the two Olympus patents as a clean-room base for compressed ORF by @feffef in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/716
* Hold Shift while dragging a crop handle to keep proportions by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/720
* Linux/FreeBSD: file dialogs are children of the app window (Wayland portal parent) by @jazzautomations in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/721
* Upper-case extensions: #705 is #342, fixed in 0.5.0; import/browse/sidecar coverage for .JPG, .Jpg, .NEF, .XMP by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/723
* Importing a deleted photo's file again brings it back from Recently Deleted (#706) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/726
* Web: a failed render worker start no longer shifts the other workers' slots (#229) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/728
* Denoise: a running job's picture is Ready only when the job reports, not when its file appears (#719) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/729
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: apply embedded Fujifilm RAF distortion and vignetting tables by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/734
* Linux: default to XWayland for file drag-and-drop on Wayland desktops by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/738
* README: add a Simplified Chinese translation (zh-hans) by @lzjtugjc in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/749
* LR-BEHAV-LOCALIZE: craft-fonts faces of other scripts are UI fallbacks (#736) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/750
* LR-PREF-DISPLAY: macOS previews follow the screen's profile, so they match exports (#787) by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/791
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: apply DNG WarpRectilinear2 lens corrections (Pixel DNGs, #635) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/794
* Color Grading: Shift-drag saturation lock, range tabs, per-wheel eye (#737, #559) by @sajibsrs in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/825
* fix(export): expose all nine watermark positions and adjustable inset by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/833
* fix(previews): shard new smart previews while retaining legacy files by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/834
* LR-EXP-WATERMARK: preview the watermark in the Export dialog (#827) by @john01px2022 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/843
* LR-EXP-WATERMARK: separate horizontal and vertical watermark insets (#827, stacked on #833) by @john01px2022 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/845
* LR-EXP-WATERMARK: rotate the watermark in quarter turns (#827, stacked on #845) by @john01px2022 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/847
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: read an untagged camera JPEG in the colour space the raw's EXIF states (#778) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/854
* LR-BEHAV-UNDO: keep file history consistent after failed renames by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/874
* fix(sliders): nudge selected sliders with the wheel and arrow keys by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/884
* Progress docs: gaps.md reviewed after 0.6.0 by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/887
* README: point the font-standard note at craft-fonts (#826) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/890
* LR-VIEW-ZOOM: sharp 1:1 in Compare and Reference (zoom windows per pane) by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/900
* Open Library recognises a Lightroom catalog and offers to import it (#891) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/907
* Drafts keep the wide planes across a noise-reduction change (CPU NR drag) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/923
* Export: Remove location info also covers Original and DNG formats by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/925
* Content-aware Remove: inpaint crate (PatchMatch) and a Fill spot mode by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/926
* Perf: parallel preview builds and faster hue/saturation tables by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/927
* Soft proofing against printer ICC profiles: intent, Simulate Paper & Ink, device gamut warning by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/928
* View: Lights Out (Shift+L), like Lightroom Classic by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/945
* Library switching: New Library…, Open Recent Library, library name in the title by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/946
* Library: create folders on disk and move photos between folders by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/947
* Reverse geocoding: fill City / State / Country from GPS (offline GeoNames) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/948
* UI: favorite themes and appearance shortcuts by @luniiya in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/950
* Fix #812: the window's renderer can't kill the start-up (DX12 shader errors) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/951
* LR-EXP-PSD: Edit in PhotoCraft (right-click Edit In, flat PSD hand-off) by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/953
* masking: keep zoom and pan while masking; improve sky mask edges by @David-T-Campos in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/547
* Remember the last crop aspect as the default by @danielspruce in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/617
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: Sony ARW6 (Compressed RAW 2) decoder for the ILCE-7RM6 by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/625
* LR-EDIT-LIGHT-HIGHLIGHTS: keep local contrast under Highlights and Shadows by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/645
* HDR: read crs:HDREditMode from XMP into hdr.enabled by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/663
* HDR: PNG export as 16-bit Rec. 2020 PQ (cICP, cLLI) by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/664
* LRC-LIB-CATALOG-IMPORT: find moved root folders relative to the catalog by @mrpdaemon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/667
* UI: Add system appearance and light themes by @luniiya in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/683
* HDR: HDR button next to B&W in the Edit panel header (as Lightroom) by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/688
* Settings ▸ Faces: Recognise faces stays off until a recognition model is chosen (#678) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/698
* AI Denoise: run tiles on another computer's graphics card (remote offload) by @akvaithi in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/813
* Integration batch 31: translations, raw header previews, XMP import warnings, Apple Photos, HDR histogram, JPEG XL, Edit In for many photos by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/998
* Report unsupported XMP profiles & geometry during photo import by @bogusyogi in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/434
* LR-EXP-PHOTOS: add exported files to Apple Photos (macOS, #236) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/643
* HDR: HDR histogram for HDR edits (fixed 5-stop scale, Lightroom layout) by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/677
* Complete Simplified Chinese (zh-hans) catalog by @Twdhsi-666 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/725
* LR-IMP-PREVIEW-READ: a preview reads the raw's header, not the raw (56.5 MB → 5.9 MB, 10 s → 1 s over SMB) by @lzjtugjc in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/755
* Updated Russian translation (again) by @wondarkus in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/822
* fix(windows): preserve legacy MSI install folders via App Paths by @THEtheChad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/879

name: LightCraft v0.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Integrate 59 community PRs (batches 21–23) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/657
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Sony ILCE-7CR samples in the corpus by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/524
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: bundled Sony ILCE-7CR camera profile by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/526
* LR-PRE-AMOUNT: presets with the Grain group apply at any amount by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/530
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: calibrate rejected every ILCE-7RM4 file (camera JPEG proxy a pixel short) by @rock-meister in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/531
* LRC-DEV-PROCESS: process versions, so a look change can ship without changing existing edits (#146) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/533
* LRC-LIB-SMARTCOLL: grouped rule menu, 17 new fields, validation, smart-album references, date and album pickers by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/536
* LRC-LIB-CATALOG-IMPORT: read Lightroom's Custom white balance by its as-shot shift on relative-WB raws (#510) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/540
* i18n: add French translation catalog and menu options by @enzoflayac in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/541
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Sony black levels: SR2 layouts and lossless M/S pedestal by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/542
* #538: breadcrumbs open their folder as spelled; fix browse test on Windows by @HarrisXiu in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/549
* LR-CROP-STRAIGHTEN: rotation pointer, angle readout and an Angle field in the crop tool (#534) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/550
* LR-BEHAV-BG-TASKS: demo scenes: a rayon worker renders a scene alone, never in parallel (deadlock) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/557
* LR-BEHAV-TEXTFIELD: a shared text field with Cut / Copy / Paste, Esc and Return that work by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/561
* Use the system clock in the CLI and headless MCP sessions (#554) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/562
* Export a contact sheet of photos to a paginated PDF by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/563
* Add Ukrainian interface translation by @dmatviichuk in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/564
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Sony ARWs shot with DRO no longer start with the camera JPEG's lifted shadows (#244) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/568
* Cmd+= / Cmd+- / Cmd+0 zoom the photo, not egui's interface scale (#566) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/570
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: Reload from Disk reads a file's lens data and turns the correction on for untouched photos by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/571
* Keep the current-view selection after permanent photo deletion by @midasdf in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/572
* docs: explain Codex MCP setup and external libraries by @pikkemaat in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/574
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Sony ARW white balance and black level from one SR2SubIFD decryptor by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/575
* LRC-LIB-KEYWORDS: a Keyword List to create, edit and reorganize keywords (stacked on #561) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/578
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: Sony 16:9 crop on pre-crop-tag bodies by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/580
* LR-IMP-PROFILES: XMP channel curves only with the master and all three channel curves by @Exalted5373 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/581
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: a partial camera look instead of the dark neutral fallback when the full look misses the gates by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/583
* Nix: bump craft-fonts pin to fix nix build / nix run by @GarrettGR in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/584
* LRC-LIB-KEYWORDS: a selection-aware Keywording box (stacked on #578) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/585
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: treat DNG samples piled up below the stated white level as clipped (#548) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/586
* LRC-LIB-KEYWORDS: Edit Keyword Set (stacked on #585) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/588
* LRC-LIB-KEYWORDS: import and export keyword lists by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/592
* LRC-LIB-LIBFOLDERS: folder colour labels (folder records, catalog format v4) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/597
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: read the two-field 12-bit ORF layout of old Olympus compacts by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/600
* raw: name Nikon High Efficiency NEFs instead of blaming a missing table (#193) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/603
* LRC-LIB-LIBFOLDERS: Synchronize Folder (stacked on #597) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/604
* LR-IMP-ADD-DIALOG: initialize layouts before import timing and tag clicks by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/608
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: HEIC decodes like libheif; release builds include it by @Exalted5373 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/609
* LR-PREF-DISPLAY: monitor ICC profiles (display colour management) by @kelanna in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/612
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: CR2 black level from the masked columns only by @Exalted5373 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/615
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Olympus ORF starting look fitted to its own JPEG by @Exalted5373 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/616
* chore: bump github actions to fix Node 20 deprecation warnings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/621
* docs: register the MCP server from an installed release by @sawizzle in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/623
* LR-EDIT-AUTO: Lightroom-like Auto, calibrated on Lightroom's Auto results by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/628
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: decode Nikon "lossy after split" NEF by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/633
* Add OmaStore manifest by @KitsuneSemCalda in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/636
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: Sony DSC-R1 .SR2 decodes (big-endian 16-bit words in a little-endian TIFF) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/640
* HDR editing and HDR export: gain map JPEG, PQ AVIF, float TIFF by @akvaithi in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/646
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: decode the padded 12.8 bpp Olympus ORF layout (E-300, E-500, E-330; E-M5 II and PEN-F high res) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/651
* LR-EDIT-DETAIL-DENOISE: fix shared-memory races in GPU denoising by @QuirkyTurtle94 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/500
